scope: Fourteen measured metadata assertions in five exact Phase0 subtests. Sources, runtime/value/error/canonical oracles and test plans preserved.

assertions.before: is($unresolved_meta->{raw_perl_dependency_count}, 0, 'unresolved helper rule can still report zero raw-Perl fallback dependency count');
assertions.after: is($unresolved_meta->{raw_perl_dependency_count}, 1, 'unresolved helper rule also reports its raw $x expression dependency');

assertions.before: is_deeply($combo_meta->{raw_perl_dependency_statements}, ['my $tmp = 1'], 'combo rule exposes raw-Perl fallback dependency statements');
assertions.after: is_deeply($combo_meta->{raw_perl_dependency_statements}, ['my $tmp = 1', '$x'], 'combo rule exposes fallback and inner raw-expression dependency statements');

assertions.before: is_deeply($combo_meta->{language_agnostic_action_ir_blocker_statements}, ['my $tmp = 1', 'return(Leaf, $x)'], 'combo rule exposes combined language-agnostic blocker statements');
assertions.after: is_deeply($combo_meta->{language_agnostic_action_ir_blocker_statements}, ['my $tmp = 1', '$x', 'return(Leaf, $x)'], 'combo rule exposes combined language-agnostic blocker statements');

assertions.before: is($combo_meta->{language_agnostic_action_ir_blocker_statement_count}, 2, 'combo rule exposes combined blocker statement count');
assertions.after: is($combo_meta->{language_agnostic_action_ir_blocker_statement_count}, 3, 'combo rule exposes combined blocker statement count');

assertions.before: is($summary->{language_agnostic_blocker_statement_total_count}, 2, 'migration summary tracks total blocker statement count across blocked rules');
assertions.after: is($summary->{language_agnostic_blocker_statement_total_count}, 3, 'migration summary tracks total blocker statement count across blocked rules');

assertions.before: is_deeply($unresolved_row->{blocker_statements}, ['return(Leaf, $x)'], 'migration summary blocked entry preserves unresolved-helper blocker payload');
assertions.after: is_deeply($unresolved_row->{blocker_statements}, ['$x', 'return(Leaf, $x)'], 'migration summary blocked entry preserves raw-expression and unresolved-helper blocker payloads');

assertions.before: is_deeply($summary->{language_agnostic_blocked_unresolved_helper_only_rules}, ['UnresolvedOnly'], 'migration summary exposes deterministic unresolved-helper-only blocked-rule list');
assertions.after: is_deeply($summary->{language_agnostic_blocked_unresolved_helper_only_rules}, [], 'migration summary exposes deterministic unresolved-helper-only blocked-rule list');

assertions.before: is_deeply($summary->{language_agnostic_blocked_mixed_rules}, ['Mixed'], 'migration summary exposes deterministic mixed blocked-rule list');
assertions.after: is_deeply($summary->{language_agnostic_blocked_mixed_rules}, ['UnresolvedOnly', 'Mixed'], 'migration summary exposes deterministic mixed blocked-rule list');

assertions.before: is($meta->{raw_perl_dependency_count}, 0, 'method-style return with leading-space args reports zero raw-perl dependency');
assertions.after: is($meta->{raw_perl_dependency_count}, 2, 'method-style return reports its authored host map and reference expression dependencies');

assertions.before: ok($meta->{language_agnostic_action_ir_ready}, 'method-style return with leading-space args remains language-agnostic action-IR ready');
assertions.after: ok(!$meta->{language_agnostic_action_ir_ready}, 'method-style return with authored host operands is not language-agnostic action-IR ready');
